title: Remember to Pray

body:
After John had explained his exciting business opportunity, Dan paused for a moment before responding. “John, have you prayed about this decision?” Dan asked. “On paper, everything looks wonderful, but there may be something that you cannot possibly see. Give God a chance to give you some advice.”

John sat up straighter in his chair. “Thank you, Dan. I nearly made a life-changing decision without seeking the most important feedback of all,” he exclaimed.

God’s people eliminated the nations inhabiting Canaan just as God commanded. The Gibeonites feared Israel, so they altered their appearance to trick the Israelites into believing that they were not Canaanites at all. They requested safety from Israel. The Israelite leaders inspected them, but forgot to seek wisdom from God.

The Israelites sampled their provisions but did not inquire of the Lord (Joshua 9:14).

As a result of their haste, the Israelites made an alliance with the Gibeonites, violating their divine instructions. Negative consequences followed.

THOUGHT FOR TODAY: A decision made without prayer may lead to trouble.
